title: The first note
status: Draft timing; new inhale and strum poses await visual approval

beats.label: Is anyone listening?
beats.direction: A quiet upward look. Give the thought time to read.

beats.label: Find the breath
beats.direction: Eyes close, mouth stays closed, upper chest lifts subtly.

beats.label: One down-strum
beats.direction: A single clear downstroke. The fretting hand and instrument remain stable.

beats.label: Mean the first note
beats.direction: The voice opens; hold the conviction. No automatic return to neutral.
